tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The authenticated caller's own profile (id, email, name, language). Takes no arguments. IDs are 6-character case-sensitive alphanumeric strings. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. Distances are integer meters. Durations are integer seconds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trip_write, person_write · Private data: person_read, person_write, leg_write, track_write, resume · Public sink: whoami, trip_read, trip_write, person_write, track_write · Destructive: trip_write, ship_write, person_write, leg_write, track_read, track_write.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trip_write, person_write · Private data: person_read, person_write, leg_write, track_write, resume · Public sink: whoami, trip_read, trip_write, person_write, track_write · Destructive: trip_write, ship_write, person_write, leg_write, track_read, track_write

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
